title: How Moonlite Fiesta began in Chicago
summary: He played it on trombone at the Grand Terrace with Duke accompanying, and Duke then arranged it.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: When the lyrics come along, it brings about a new title, then. Uh huh. Now back to Moonlite Fiesta -- do you remember how you happened to write that or where you were?
Well, I played it myself on the trombone at the house in Chicago. In Chicago, we were at the Cabaret where Earl Hines used to be for years.

Yeah, I guess so -- I guess that's what they called it. I played it in there, and I think we were playing there for something; I don't know what it was, and I played it with Duke -- I played it myself and Duke accompanied
me, and that's the way it started, I guess. From then on, Duke decided to write an arrangement on it or something, you know? And put it on a record.
